reviews.title: Great fans, garbage software
reviews.comment: Fans are great. Lighting is diffused well with ring and hub lighting (phone camera shows led hot spots worse than they are in person). Reverse blades fit my application great. Hardware gets 5 stars easily. Software leaves much to be desired and is required. And there appears to be no way to integrate standard rgb/argb devices or connectors.
reviews.author: ArtyMcParty
